articles.title: US Iran war: UAE plans third crude oil pipeline to avoid Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: The United Arab Emirates is planning to construct a third oil-export pipeline to minimize reliance on the Strait of Hormuz. This new pipeline would connect the western coast of the UAE to the port of Fujairah on the eastern side. Abu Dhabi National Oil Co. is considering this initiative to bolster its oil supply capabilities. The pipeline could also be utilized by third parties, increasing overall efficiency.

articles.title: Title-chasing McIlroy says there's no risk playing in Abu Dhabi amid tensions in Middle East
articles.description: Rory McIlroy has played down safety concerns about competing at the Abu Dhabi Championship this week amid tensions in the Middle East that have impacted the sports calendar in the region. It is the first of back-to-back season-ending events in the United Arab Emirates over the next two weeks that will determine who wins the year-long Race to Dubai title. McIlroy is third in the standings as he chases a record-tying eighth title. The tour decided to stick to the upcoming schedule of Abu Dhabi and Dubai amid increased security concerns in the Middle East because of the Israel-Iran war. McIlroy says “I don’t think I would ever feel unsafe.”
